card.name: The word potentially before hazardous or fatal
card.fires_on: The word "potentially" (or the ending of POTENTIALLY in capitals) right before "hazardous" or "fatal" in warnings about driving, machinery or respiratory depression.

modes.label: Before hazardous activities
modes.description: "potentially" comes right before hazardous tasks or activities such as driving, in warnings about impaired abilities.
modes.example: may impair the mental and/or physical abilities required for the performance of<< potentially>> hazardous tasks, such as driving a vehicle

modes.label: Before fatal effects
modes.description: "potentially" comes right before fatal respiratory depression after "may cause".
modes.example: which could increase or prolong adverse drug effects and may cause<< potentially>> fatal respiratory depression.

modes.label: Capitalized heading
modes.description: The ending of POTENTIALLY in an all-caps warning heading about driving.
modes.example: WARNING: IMPAIRED ABILITY TO DRIVE OR ENGAGE IN OTHER POTENTI<<ALLY>> HAZARDOUS ACTIVITIES

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest words about negative or absolute values, and the suppressed ones suggest danger words; the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the word "potentially" just before a warning word such as hazardous or fatal.
